about: Neighbour footprints within 200 m of the facility point, with heights (simplified) and their source; rings in metres relative to the facility point (x east, y north, the tool’s local frame). Footprints: Public Safety Canada, Canada Structures (12 Sep 2025; Open Government Licence - Canada; doi:10.82126/z1bc-zd72); heights: Canada Structures only. No height on record = null (draw flat, never guess)., project decision.
name: Sobeys Data Centre

useSources.osm: OpenStreetMap places inside the footprint (ODbL 1.0, (c) OpenStreetMap contributors
useSources.licence: City of Edmonton Open Data, Business Licences (qhi4-bdpu; OGL-Edmonton) inside the footprint, use class our reading of the licence type
useSources.zoning: City of Edmonton Zoning Bylaw 20001 geographical data (OGL-Edmonton) at the building centre; zone -> class our reading

useShare.note: recorded = OpenStreetMap places or City business licences inside the outline; zoned = the City zone at its centre (‘zoned for’); none = no source
